question: Vineet starts from Point Y and drives 10 km towards the North. He then takes a right turn, drives 29 km, turns right and drives 34 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 13 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 24 km and stops at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified)
solution:
Given:

Vineet starts from Point Y and drives 10 km towards the North.

He then takes a right turn, drives 29 km, turns right and drives 34 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 13 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 24 km and stops at Point Z. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/946a5abeb35f861d921675f233f158f6c06d2d24606d8470f97630a7005cf68a.png] 

Thus, Vineet should drive (29 km - 13 km) 16 km in the west direction to reach Point Y again.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
